svg.title: Yellow Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Original Kelly painting is the small lower-left image in museum guide PDF3/printed4. The four larger quilt images are Ben Millett works and are not transcribed.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://desmoinesartcenter.org/news/ellsworth-kelly-foundation-gift/; source object 1971.17; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
